<script id="wix-first-paint">
    if (window.ResizeObserver &&
        (!window.PerformanceObserver || !PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes.indexOf('paint') === -1)) {
        new ResizeObserver(function (entries, observer) {
            entries.some(function (entry) {
                var contentRect = entry.contentRect;
                if (contentRect.width > 0 && contentRect.height > 0) {
                    requestAnimationFrame(function (now) {
                        window.wixFirstPaint = now;
                        dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('wixFirstPaint'));
                    });
                    observer.disconnect();
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }).observe(document.body);
    }
</script>


<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">
    const div = document.createElement('div')
    div.style.overflowY = 'scroll'
    div.style.width = '50px'
    div.style.height = '50px'
    div.style.visibility = 'hidden'
    document.body.appendChild(div)
    const scrollbarWidth= div.offsetWidth - div.clientWidth
    document.body.removeChild(div)
    if(scrollbarWidth > 0){
        document.body.style.setProperty('--scrollbar-width', `${scrollbarWidth}px`)
    }
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  var ANCHOR_ID = 'comp-mnz7lloh';
  var urls = [
    'https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2375c_3c43d1e138da4cf6a799c0400a159891~mv2.jpg',
    'https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2375c_dccc01e678684fbaa0297b049755a1ed~mv2.jpg',
    'https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2375c_87b6bb6db3774a9893f044c07924da30~mv2.jpg',
    'https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2375c_ff7c007574034bfa8178fc19e285a0f6~mv2.jpg',
    'https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2375c_55b641944a8e481bbe18ad9dd9cf753c~mv2.jpg',
    'https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b2375c_e4b887db975e47d2a5ef68afe5102ce4~mv2.jpg'
  ];
  var done = false;

  function build(anchor) {
    if (done) return;
    if (anchor.querySelector('#tg-loop')) { done = true; return; }
    done = true;
    console.log('[tg-loop] building slideshow in', anchor.id);

    var innerIframe = anchor.querySelector('iframe, wix-iframe');
    if (innerIframe) innerIframe.style.display = 'none';
    anchor.style.position = 'relative';
    anchor.style.minHeight = '100vh';

    var loop = document.createElement('div');
    loop.id = 'tg-loop';
    urls.forEach(function(u) {
      var s = document.createElement('div');
      s.className = 'tg-slide';
      var img = document.createElement('img');
      img.src = u;
      img.setAttribute('fetchpriority', 'high');
      img.alt = '';
      s.appendChild(img);
      loop.appendChild(s);
    });
    anchor.appendChild(loop);

    var imgs = loop.querySelectorAll('img');
    var loaded = 0;
    imgs.forEach(function(img) {
      function ready() { loaded++; if (loaded === imgs.length) loop.classList.add('tg-ready'); }
      if (img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0) ready();
      else { img.onload = ready; img.onerror = ready; }
    });
  }

  function tryBuild() {
    var anchor = document.getElementById(ANCHOR_ID);
    if (anchor) { build(anchor); return true; }
    return false;
  }

  // Try immediately
  if (tryBuild()) return;

  // If not found, watch the DOM for it
  var observer = new MutationObserver(function() {
    if (tryBuild()) observer.disconnect();
  });
  observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  // Safety fallback: try again after page load
  window.addEventListener('load', tryBuild);
  setTimeout(tryBuild, 3000);
  setTimeout(tryBuild, 6000);
})();
</script>
